title: Mzieme language - Wikipedia
text: Mzieme Naga. Mzieme is a Sino-Tibetan language spoken in India. It has been called Northern Zeme due to its lack of official recognition, but is not particularly close to Zeme.

title: Naga, Mzieme Language (NME)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Mzieme Naga is a stable indigenous language of India. It belongs to the Sino-Tibetan language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.

title: Mzieme language — Grokipedia
text: Mzieme is a Sino-Tibetan language spoken primarily in the Indian states of Nagaland and Manipur by members of the Zeme Naga ethnic group.
